title: Feeds
takeaway: Personalized, Following, and date-oriented feeds serve different reading intentions.
decision: Expose Balanced, Fresh, Discover, and Following choices instead of one opaque ranking.

title: Community Onboarding FAQ
takeaway: Members can choose relevant channels and roles and revise those choices later.
decision: Treat joined communities and explicitly followed topics as editable interests.

title: Reddit’s Approach to Content Recommendations
takeaway: Recommendations combine content, activity, subscriptions, settings, filtering, explanations, and negative feedback.
decision: Provide personalization off, muted topics, truthful story reasons, and explicit more/less feedback.

title: Understanding Discourse Trust Levels
takeaway: Community participation and permission systems need explicit, understandable rules; newer permissions can target groups.
decision: Keep owner/member permissions distinct from feed ranking and avoid fabricated reputation inputs.

title: What are tags, and how should I use them?
takeaway: Clear topic tags connect people to relevant questions and explain what a category means.
decision: Use visible followed-topic chips as explicit interest signals rather than hidden broad category assumptions.

title: Help:Watchlist
takeaway: A personal watchlist narrows a busy update stream to pages the reader chooses and can unwatch.
decision: Store followed topics per authenticated account and make removal easy.

title: Reading strategies
takeaway: Conversation, recent, combined, and focused views support different ways of catching up.
decision: Offer a Fresh reading mode and keep channel conversation navigation separate from discovery controls.

title: Public Rooms
takeaway: People discover communities through topic search, directories, previews, and explicit joining.
decision: Use real community joins as an interest source and preserve an easy path from discovery into community channels.

title: Get to know Feed
takeaway: Membership shapes the feed, and the For you sort combines recent and active posts.
decision: Combine community affinity with recency while keeping freshness adjustable and the cold-start feed usable.

title: Understanding and setting up a Feed
takeaway: The feed aggregates posts from spaces a member has joined.
decision: Label community-derived interests plainly and keep a Following balance option.

title: Community Features
takeaway: Community spaces combine feeds, chat, questions, events, and member discovery.
decision: Connect feed discovery to actual community participation instead of inventing engagement activity.

title: How can I recommend other publications on Substack?
takeaway: A short reason can help readers decide whether a recommendation is worth exploring; recommendations can be removed.
decision: Show Why this story only when real backend explanations exist, and keep topic choices reversible.

title: Recommendations
takeaway: Publishers can recommend other sites with a customized title and description.
decision: Retain recognizable source metadata and explain discovery without suggesting an unverified endorsement.

title: WordPress Feeds
takeaway: RSS and Atom expose recent publisher content, while comment feeds are a distinct stream.
decision: Preserve publisher source and publication metadata so freshness ranking reflects actual article data.

title: Refine recommendations
takeaway: Readers can manage follows and mutes, hide stories, and clear reading history to adjust recommendations.
decision: Add followed and muted topic controls plus a clearly scoped reset of learned reading feedback.

title: Customizing Your Feed
takeaway: Followed tags/users shape recommendations; hidden tags can be managed and restored; saved reading lists are separate.
decision: Keep explicit follows, mutes, and bookmarks distinct from learned history, with editable topic chips.

title: The journey behind Hashnode’s new personalized feed
takeaway: Followed tags, authors, subscriptions, and reading interests help make a feed relevant.
decision: Use real explicit and behavioral interests and expose their provenance in the Tune your feed dialog.

title: How can I add/create a Mute Filter?
takeaway: Keyword or phrase filters can remove unwanted content across chosen feeds.
decision: Allow up to 20 editable muted topics and persist them on the server.

title: Read only the articles you want
takeaway: Server-side filters keep or remove matching articles consistently across devices; duplicate filtering reduces repeated stories.
decision: Apply muted preferences before ranking and preserve source diversity and duplicate suppression in the feed.

title: How to Personalize Flipboard
takeaway: Readers can tune followed topics, request less of a story type, mute sources, and inspect why a story appeared.
decision: Make Tune your feed accessible from the feed and pair adjustable recommendations with honest reasons.

title: Daily Digest
takeaway: Discovery can resurface saved content alongside new feed items, while the digest remains optional.
decision: Keep bookmarks useful after a history reset and avoid forced streaks or attention-pressure badges.

title: Guardian app
takeaway: Followed topics personalize news.
decision: Keep followed topics explicit and editable.
